reviews.text: A fun and strategic deck-building RPG with roguelike elements and plenty of heroes to collect. If you enjoy tactical battles and clever card combos, this one’s worth checking out.
An epic card game with several classes, many warriors, and a rich combat system. Create an unbeatable deck and conquer an entire island.
A role-playing card game. Venture into the mysterious Sovereign’s Island with a diverse cast of Heroes, strengthening your decks through battles and encounters.
